video_title: BEHIND THE SCENES AT PELICANS MEDIA DAY & I SIGNED WITH NEW BALANCE

quotes.speaker: Trey Murphy III
quotes.summary_phrase: Trey Murphy III on his new partnership with New Balance
quotes.excerpt: Dejounte introduced me to Chris Davis, the president of New Balance, and we are in Boston.
quotes.quote: Shout out to New Balance. Actually, in all honesty, shout out to Dejounte Murray. Dejounte introduced me to Chris Davis, the president of New Balance, and we are in Boston. We talked, and from that talk, it led to me working with New Balance. So, first of all, thank you to Dejounte. Make sure he gets his flowers here, but also thank you to New Balance for believing in me.

quotes.speaker: Trey Murphy III
quotes.summary_phrase: Trey Murphy III on his offseason experiences and growth
quotes.excerpt: I just try to do a bunch of different things, have a lot of experiences.
quotes.quote: I just try to do a bunch of different things, have a lot of experiences. I am all about experiences. I went to the French Open, I went to F1 in Monaco, I went to the US Open. I just try to do a bunch of different things, have a lot of experiences, because I am all about experiences.

quotes.speaker: Trey Murphy III
quotes.summary_phrase: Trey Murphy III on the importance of winning games
quotes.excerpt: I think the team is winning, like the sport is important and this league is winning games.
quotes.quote: I think the team is winning, like the sport is important and this league is winning games, and that is what I focus on, is winning games. And after that, that is when the personal things will come into the fold.

quotes.speaker: Trey Murphy III
quotes.summary_phrase: Trey Murphy III on his breakout game against the Hornets
quotes.excerpt: It was a game against Charlotte Hornets my rookie year, and I had 32 points, eight threes.
quotes.quote: In my career, I would say my breakout was a game against Charlotte Hornets my rookie year, and I had 32 points, eight threes. And it was probably the first game that I felt like a real NBA player, and you know, since then I kind of had a look back.

quotes.speaker: Trey Murphy III
quotes.summary_phrase: Trey Murphy III on his physical development and playoff experience
quotes.excerpt: Having that physical strength was pretty big for me and also just working on my in-between game.
quotes.quote: I was playing in the playoffs and winning games and doing well during that time. So, having that physical strength was pretty big for me and also just working on my in-between game.
